candidates.hook_ar: 20/20 مو يعني نظرك ممتاز… يعني نظرك عادي.

candidates.hook_ar: ما راح تصدق شنو يصير لعيونك ثقب

candidates.payoff: Why it works, safe replication, what it does not prove

claims.text: Pinhole improvement suggests refractive error, not a diagnosis

candidates.hook_ar: نتيجة فحص نظرك 20/20؟ هذا ما يعني إن عيونك سليمة.

candidates.continuation: Acuity measures sharpness at distance; an exam checks more
candidates.payoff: Why a full exam still matters, without fear

claims.text: 20/20 acuity does not replace a comprehensive eye exam
